_how: List real engine loops here and they appear as voices in the app on every device. Put the audio files (MP3/WAV/OGG) in this samples/ folder. Each voice needs one or more loops; several loops recorded at different RPMs crossfade for extra realism. 'rpm' is the engine speed the loop was recorded at — an estimate is fine (idle ~900, cruise ~3000, high ~5500). Example voice: {"key": "mustang", "name": "Mustang GT", "emoji": "🐎", "loops": [{"file": "mustang_idle.mp3", "rpm": 900}, {"file": "mustang_mid.mp3", "rpm": 3000}, {"file": "mustang_high.mp3", "rpm": 5500}]}
